findings.title: Relative-to-residual tolerance certifies false emptiness after pure-target cancellation
findings.description: For the exact frozen a=ones input, Y[:,0]=1 and all remaining entries0, rho=0 is feasible with s=e0,U=0, and positive-definite M forces U=0 at zero budget, so the exact identified set is the singleton {e0}. The helper computes center0=1.0000000000000016 and J0=2.349281189348694e-29 from projection roundoff, then tol=1e-9*J0 and returns EMPTY. The same input with rho=1e-20 is also incorrectly EMPTY. This is a finite wrong classification with an exact witness, not a valid ambiguity or missing physical input. A homogeneous floor based only on rho squared and computed J0 cannot cover cancellation against the nonzero data norm.
findings.expected: SINGLETON_EXACT_STRUCTURAL at rho=0, or conservative BOUNDARY_UNCERTAIN pending structural recognition; never EMPTY. For exactly repeated rows and rho>0, BALL with center equal to the shared row and radius rho/ell.
findings.minimal_fix: Handle exactly pure-target data structurally for frozen a=ones, and include a homogeneous whitened-data projection-error bound for the remaining boundary decision; return typed uncertainty for unresolved nonzero residuals.

Reuse the exact retained R31 source sha256:b4c20f3595fc1148ff387df3b012ce7fd87dae4098be16a0d24dd914d183291f, all six 7x9 matrices, a=ones(7), both fixed metrics, signed full24 carrier, corrected Nc/Nz transport, ell/c values and unchanged rank/Fc/KKT/full24 gates. Correct only identified-set boundary evaluation, its narrow regressions, corresponding prose/result fields and required generated packaging. First exploit structural facts that are exactly decidable for this frozen finite input: with verified a=ones(7), finite Y has J0=0 exactly iff all seven rows agree entrywise as binary64 values interpreted as exact supplied reals. In that exact repeated-row case take s0 from that common row, J0=0, rho=0 gives an exact singleton, and rho>0 gives a ball of radius rho/ell without first squaring rho; never use approximate row equality to force a nonzero residual to zero. At rho=0, any exactly unequal finite rows prove the set empty for this a=ones model. This handles the nonzero pure-target counterexample and zero data algebraically without changing the model. For rho>0 with genuinely nonzero or unresolved residual, account for projection/whitening cancellation in homogeneous amplitude units. With K=L L^T, let Z=L^-1 Y, b=L^-1 a, q=b/||b||, E=(I-q q^T)Z; exact J0=||E||_F^2. If the implemented whitened residual Ehat has a justified total norm-error bound delta_E (including factorization, triangular solves and projection, with dependence on the retained matrix conditioning), then J0 lies between max(0,||Ehat||_F-delta_E)^2 and (||Ehat||_F+delta_E)^2; equivalently its squared error is at most 2||Ehat||_F delta_E+delta_E^2. Use this inequality to cover the cancellation error, together with the existing relative squared-budget tolerance1e-9 and the rounding error in rho^2. delta_E must scale linearly with ||Z||_F or an equivalent conservative whitened-data norm; the resulting squared error and decision tolerance must scale quadratically under Y,rho -> alpha Y,alpha rho. Do not restore max(1,...) or a dimensionful floor. An implementable conservative numerical-policy scale is1e-9*max(rho^2,Jhat,||Z||_F^2), provided the factor/solve/projection error is checked to be covered; this policy alone must not be advertised as a rigorous all-input interval certificate. If that coverage cannot be established or the gap/error interval overlaps zero, return an explicit NUMERIC_BOUNDARY_HOLD/BOUNDARY_UNCERTAIN with radius=None and the uncertainty/error-scale explanation, rather than EMPTY, zero-radius singleton, clipping J0, or truncating a direction. Resolve any larger factor/rank error with a typed numeric refusal; do not relax the fixed scientific gates. Retain the exact-equality singleton theorem separately from finite-precision boundary classification. Under fixed binary64 input, exact repeated rows and zero-budget row inequality are structural certificates; general computed near-equality is only a numerical uncertainty unless separately established. Add regressions for exactly repeated nonzero rows (single coordinate and mixed signed24 vector), rho=0 and tinypositive/ordinary rho, across all six branches and both metrics at amplitude scales1e-6,1,1e6; test exact unequal-row zero-budget EMPTY so the shortcut cannot erase a real residual. Add near-pure-target perturbations at positive rho on both sides of the uncertainty region, accepting typed uncertainty when precision is insufficient and comparing resolvable cases to an independent SVD or bounded high-precision solve on the same cached matrices. Preserve the existing generic EMPTY/equality/BALL, zero-data, domain-rejection, radius/center scaling and all12 null-lift tests. Re-execute only the cached consumer and affected tests/report packaging, show numerical parity of unchanged ell/c/old branch values, and return the exact new candidate plus first raw outcomes to fresh independent review. No reintegration, WMAP/row extension, sky/catalogue/noise/ODE/native run, new physical model, new ultra allocation, accounting reset, full provenance rerun or original42 promotion.
